\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}\usetikzlibrary{shapes.geometric}
\typeout{STZ PGF VERSION \pgfversion}\pagestyle{empty}\makeatletter
\newwrite\fixtureout\immediate\openout\fixtureout=geometry.txt
\def\traceaspect#1{

  \def\pgfshapeaspect{#1}%
  % Invert
  \pgfutil@tempdima=#1pt%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE aspectSp; \number\pgfutil@tempdima}%

  \pgfutil@tempdima=.125\pgfutil@tempdima%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE aspectEighthSp; \number\pgfutil@tempdima}%

  \c@pgf@counta=\pgfutil@tempdima\relax% 8192*determinant
  \pgfutil@tempdima=8192pt%
  \divide\pgfutil@tempdima by\c@pgf@counta%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE inverseSp; \number\pgfutil@tempdima}%

  \edef\pgfshapeaspectinverse{\pgf@sys@tonumber{\pgfutil@tempdima}}%
}
\def\tracediamond{\begingroup
\expandafter\traceaspect\expandafter{\pgfshapeaspect}

    %
    % Calculate width and height of the inner rectangle
    %
    \pgf@xa=.5\wd\pgfnodeparttextbox%
    \pgfmathsetlength\pgf@xc{\pgfkeysvalueof{/pgf/inner xsep}}%
    \advance\pgf@xa by\pgf@xc%
    \pgf@ya=.5\ht\pgfnodeparttextbox%
    \advance\pgf@ya by.5\dp\pgfnodeparttextbox%
    \pgfmathsetlength\pgf@yc{\pgfkeysvalueof{/pgf/inner ysep}}%
    \advance\pgf@ya by\pgf@yc%
    %
    % Calculate width and height of diamond
    %
    \immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE initialXSp; \number\pgf@xa}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE initialYSp; \number\pgf@ya}%
\pgf@x=\pgf@xa%
    \advance\pgf@x by\pgfshapeaspect\pgf@ya%
\pgf@xb=\pgf@x\advance\pgf@xb by-\pgf@xa%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE aspectYSp; \number\pgf@xb}%

    \pgf@y=\pgfshapeaspectinverse\pgf@xa%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE inverseXSp; \number\pgf@y}%

    \advance\pgf@y by\pgf@ya%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE fittedXSp; \number\pgf@x}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE fittedYSp; \number\pgf@y}%

    %
    % Check against minimum height/width
    %
    \pgfmathsetlength\pgf@xb{\pgfkeysvalueof{/pgf/minimum width}}%
    \pgf@xb=.5\pgf@xb%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE minimumWidthHalfSp; \number\pgf@xb}%

    \ifdim\pgf@x<\pgf@xb%
      % yes, too small. Enlarge...
      \pgf@x=\pgf@xb%
    \fi%
    \pgfmathsetlength\pgf@yb{\pgfkeysvalueof{/pgf/minimum height}}%
    \pgf@yb=.5\pgf@yb%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE minimumHeightHalfSp; \number\pgf@yb}%

    \ifdim\pgf@y<\pgf@yb%
      % yes, too small. Enlarge...
      \pgf@y=\pgf@yb%
    \fi%
    %
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE limitedXSp; \number\pgf@x}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE limitedYSp; \number\pgf@y}%
    % Add outer border
    %
    \pgfmathsetlength\pgf@xa{\pgfkeysvalueof{/pgf/outer xsep}}%
    \immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE outerXSp; \number\pgf@xa}%
\advance\pgf@x by\pgf@xa%
    \pgfmathsetlength\pgf@ya{\pgfkeysvalueof{/pgf/outer ysep}}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE outerYSp; \number\pgf@ya}%

    \advance\pgf@y by\pgf@ya%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE anchorXSp; \number\pgf@x}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE anchorYSp; \number\pgf@y}%
\pgf@xc=\pgf@x\pgf@yc=\pgf@y
\advance\pgf@xc by-1.414213\pgf@xa
\advance\pgf@yc by-1.414213\pgf@ya
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE paintedXSp; \number\pgf@xc}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{STAGE paintedYSp; \number\pgf@yc}%

\endgroup}

\newcommand\fixedshape[8]{%
\begin{pgfpicture}\begingroup\normalfont\pgfkeys{#7}%
\setbox\pgfnodeparttextbox=\hbox{}%
\wd\pgfnodeparttextbox=#3pt\ht\pgfnodeparttextbox=#4pt\dp\pgfnodeparttextbox=#5pt%
\pgfsetlinewidth{#6pt}\immediate\write\fixtureout{CASE #1}%
\pgfmathsetlength\pgf@x{1em}\pgfmathsetlength\pgf@y{1ex}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{FONT \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}\tracediamond
\let\originalusepath\pgfusepath
\def\pgfusepath##1{\pgfgetpath\fixturepath\immediate\write\fixtureout{PAINT ##1; PATH \meaning\fixturepath}\originalusepath{##1}}%
\pgfmultipartnode{#2}{center}{fixture}{\pgfusepath{stroke}}%
\foreach\anchorname in {#8}{\pgfpointanchor{fixture}{\anchorname}\immediate\write\fixtureout{ANCHOR \anchorname; \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}}%
\endgroup\end{pgfpicture}\par}
